rationale: The 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR; the detailed Cloud task requires Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, the enabled assistant and paired SOAR. The detailed task uses existing triaged findings and qualifies first-ten burst and about 200 daily tenant limits, frontier models and connector/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task retains the older AI SOC Analyst wording. The CMP task prerequisites list Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; the linked exact setup URL returned 404 and its original scope was not renewed. The current release page states November 4 General Availability; its mapped historical Controlled Availability section is unavailable. The edition, Cloud Connect and SAIA region tables provide their own scoped context. Exact SOAR pairing, agent-specific regional rollout, entitlement and customer authorization are excluded from this decision.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
